(TRIVALENT)"}],"comment":"Dimension D21 carries a tolerance band of 0.04 mm on a part that is zinc plated, but the drawing does not state whether the ±0.02 mm limits apply before or after plating. This matters because the plating thickness can push the finished size out of tolerance and cause assembly interference. The designer should add a note clarifying whether the dimension is pre-plate or post-plate, or adjust the tolerance to allow for the coating thickness.","recommended_correction":"Add a note specifying that the 20±0.02 dimension applies after plating, or widen the tolerance to account for the I.Z.B.P. coating thickness."},{"rule_id":"TL-007","evidence":[{"kind":"dimension","ref":"D24","page":1,"quote":"⌀8   H7 THRU`"}],"comment":"The ⌀8 H7 through hole (D24) is a precision locating feature but has no surface roughness callout. Without a specified finish the machinist may leave the bore too rough for its mating pin or bushing, causing poor fit or premature wear. The designer should add a surface roughness symbol with an appropriate Ra value to this hole.","recommended_correction":"Add a surface roughness requirement (e.g., Ra 1.6 or finer) to the ⌀8 H7 hole."}]}
